Every proof is a mutation probe: one member or mechanism is removed or violated in production code, the covering tests are run one file per PHPUnit invocation, and the production file is restored from a byte copy and verified by SHA-256 (all restored). A probe counts as RED_INTENDED when a covering test FAILS (assertion) and it is the test named for that member; RED_BEHAVIOR when any non-guard test fails; the column-coverage guard alone proves column membership only. Errors without an assertion failure are never counted, except one reviewed case recorded below. The probe runs were repeated three times because the first runs found defects in the proof itself, all fixed and recorded in process_findings.

process_findings.vacuous_closure: The first probe pass found four G3 check-removal probes NOT_CAUGHT. Cause: a closure called $this->fail("Expected ".$code) inside try/catch(RuntimeException); PHPUnit failure exceptions are RuntimeExceptions and the message contained the code. Rewritten to record the refusal and assert after the try; all four probes then went RED_INTENDED.
process_findings.equivalent_mutant: G2 seed_origin was redundant (a longer stable series always changes the consumed chain itself), so its removal could not be observed. The member was removed from the reference rather than kept untested.
process_findings.probe_design: L1, L3, L4, L11, the G4 leak and the G4 context probe were redefined because they tripped a format validator (date or content-hash member) before reaching the equality assertion; they now leak through plain text members.
process_findings.static_guard_regression: The first full-suite run had 10 failures: the 8 governed ones plus two guards (CanonicalScopeFrontierAndDecisionGradeTest, TermOwnershipAndPriceProductTest) that enumerate private IndicatorVectorService methods with a $window parameter. The new helper atrStateReference declared one, and the guards counted it as a windowed computation without a warm-up guard. The parameter was renamed (the helper is not windowed); the guards were not touched; the full suite was rerun.
process_findings.rejected_strictness: A rule refusing a bar with a null acquired_at was tried and removed: it broke 20 unrelated nested-identity tests and no affected predicate requires it. A null timestamp is the consumer-visible value and is bound as null.
process_findings.probe_runs: first-pass, second-pass and third-pass probe results are retained in the package; the final results are matrix/probes_*.json
